title: A run hidden by a condition
concept: A Condition is defined in designmap.xml as a direct child of Document; a run names it in AppliedConditions, and while the condition is hidden the run is not printed.

annotations.note: The Condition is a direct child of Document in the design map, not part of Resources/Styles.xml. Its Self id is what a run names in AppliedConditions. Visible="false" hides every run that names it.
The indicator colour is a typed Properties child. InDesign ignores an IndicatorColor attribute. IndicatorMethod="UseHighlight" is the spelling InDesign writes.
ConditionalTextPreference follows the conditions: whether indicators are shown, and which condition set is active (n means none).
Conditions come before the idPkg:Preferences reference. The story's second CharacterStyleRange carries AppliedConditions="Condition/Draft", so its text does not print.
